gfxPipeline.verdict: NOT an object. gfxPipeline is a namespace of statics and has no instance layout at all.
gfxPipeline.instance_size_note: 1 because the class is empty, not because the layout is unknown. There is nothing to recover.
evidence: all 55 gfxPipeline functions in data/symbols.json carry static=true; the mangled names are @@SA / @@CA / @@CG (public static __cdecl / private static __cdecl / private static __stdcall) and not one is @@QAE or @@AAE (__thiscall)
no constructor, no destructor, no vftable, and no `this` parameter anywhere in MM2_RE_KIT/MM2_PSEUDOCODE/gfxPipeline/gfxPipeline.c
every piece of pipeline state is a named class static in .data (listed below) or a file-scope global in the same object file
gfxPipeline is never allocated: no operator new site anywhere in the kit produces one
gfxPipeline.consequence: tools/merge_layouts.py must keep refusing it, and tools/genheaders.py must keep the check_size commented out. An empty class has sizeof 1 on both sides, so a live guard would pass while certifying nothing.
